title: Independence Day script came from the CIA

tellings.quote: that whole script was like out of CIA central scripting casting.

plain: The script of Independence Day, the 1996 film about an alien invasion starring Will Smith, was shaped by the CIA, the US spy agency, as if it came straight out of "CIA central scripting casting". A UFO researcher named Steven Greer says this without naming a source. He tells it to argue that Hollywood films are used to shape how the public thinks about aliens.
